nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding the token decimals.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply.
Mapping 'balances' from address to uint storing token balances.
Nested mapping 'allowed' from owner to spender to uint storing allowances.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and assigning the entire supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() view function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address) view function returning balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address,address) view function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address,uint) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address,uint) moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moves tokens using allowance and updates balances/allowed with safeSub/safeAdd.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint) with overflow require check.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint) with underflow require check.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint) with overflow require check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint,uint) with division-by-zero require check.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and approvals.
Unchecked arithmetic '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' inside totalSupply(), not routed through SafeMath.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens of approve, the allowance amount set.
Parameter to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter from of transferFrom, the owner debited.
Parameter to of transferFrom, the recipient credited.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter a of safeAdd.
Parameter b of safeAdd.
Parameter a of safeSub.
Parameter b of safeSub.
Parameter a of safeMul.
Parameter b of safeMul.
Parameter a of safeDiv.
Parameter b of safeDiv.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the state variable name.
Constructor writes the state variable symbol.
Constructor writes the state variable decimals.
Constructor writes the state variable _totalSupply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] with the initial supply.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply and is the emit target.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply executes an unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve sets the allowance for the untrusted msg.sender.
spender parameter is the key approved in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source of funds.
to parameter is the credited recipient in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
from parameter is the debited owner in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances[from] and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for balances[to].
Parameter a is summed in safeAdd.
Parameter b is summed in safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend in safeSub.
Parameter a is a factor in safeMul.
Parameter b is a factor in safeMul.
Parameter a is the dividend in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor in safeDiv.
